Lane Blurby Business confirmed by the owner 2026-10-30. Merges after the Stage 8 release and the held branches named in phase1-specs.md. Host RodneySr for now.

Both, plus the Stage 8 release and the seven held branches, are carried as the epic charter's Constraints (merge order) and its launch-preflight start gate.
